title: Content modeling and JSON
content:
Content modeling means deciding what your data looks like before you write any of it: which fields a card has, what type each one is, and which are required. Get this right and the code that follows is easy. Get it wrong and every card is a special case.

  • Read and watch: about 15 minutes
  • Do: about 1 hour
  • You make: a cards.json file with at least 12 cards
  • You need: your properties list from Project 1 and a JSON viewer
  • Support level: medium; AI encouraged for filling in data

Read and look

  • json.org: the whole format on one page. Note there are no comments in JSON.
  • Working with JSON (MDN).
  • Real data, from HAX: open haxtheweb.org/site.json in your browser. Every HAX site is described by one file like this. Find the items array and one item's title and slug.

Do

From your properties list, write each field with its type (string, number, boolean, array) and whether it's required. Add an id: every item needs one so code can tell them apart.

Create cards.json next to my-card.js. Write one complete card by hand so you know the model works.

Give AI your model and your one example, and ask for eleven more. Use the prompt below. Then read every card it makes: AI gets types wrong, invents fields and repeats itself.

Paste the file into a JSON validator or just open it in your browser through your dev server. A single missing comma breaks the whole file.

Stuck? Ask your study buddy

Use AI to explain, not to do the work for you. Paste your own code or error with the prompt, read the answer, then close the chat and type the fix yourself. If you can't explain the fix out loud, you don't own it yet.

You're done when

Journal it

Add a heading for this page to your dev journal (the public Gist you made in Start here) and answer in Markdown:

  • Paste your model.
  • What did the AI get wrong, and how did you notice?
